backend/main.mo: Motoko canister storing submitted contact forms with validation, timestamped Map entries, and query endpoints to retrieve counts and entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two frontend gallery-related features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing pre-generated one-line summaries of all frontend components, hooks, pages, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining base layers and extensive OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata, schema.org JSON-LD, and the app root mounting script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component composing all page sections including hero, highlights, gallery, specs, FAQs, contact card, and CTA elements.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: UI-only contact information card with call and WhatsApp actions, styled with cards and buttons.
frontend/src/components/FAQs.tsx: Expandable FAQ section rendering eight leasing-related Q&A items using accordion components.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer displaying branding, contact details, disclaimer, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Gallery.tsx: Displays a grid of image cards with hover effects for the property gallery.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders a responsive header with navigation, scroll handling, and call/WhatsApp actions.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Shows a full‑screen hero image with a scroll indicator that jumps to the next section.
frontend/src/components/IdealTenants.tsx: Lists ideal tenant categories using cards with icons and brief descriptions.
frontend/src/components/Layouts.tsx: Presents layout options for leasing floors and includes a brochure download button.
frontend/src/components/Location.tsx: Displays location advantages through cards highlighting connectivity and nearby landmarks.
Provides a mobile‑only sticky bottom bar with call and WhatsApp buttons.
Shows key property highlights like area, floors, and parking in a compact grid of cards.
frontend/src/components/Specifications.t: Details property specifications including location map, features, and floor‑wise areas.
frontend/src/components/TextCTA.tsx: Renders a call‑to‑action section with a headline, scroll‑to‑contact button, and feature badges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context for Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity state, login, and logout handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a React Query mutation for submitting contact form data through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind layers and custom OKLCH‑based luxury theme colors and utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom color tokens, container settings, plugins, and extended theme options.
project_state.json: Describes project metadata and requirements for adding a new Property Gallery image and card entry.
